title: Word values lie in range
statement: Let $W,N,Q$ be natural numbers, let the limits have word bound $w$, and suppose $2(2w+2)<2^W$, $2\,\mathrm{space}<2^W$, $4Q<2^W$, and $2N<2^W$. If an integer $v$ satisfies $|v|\le w$, then $-2^W\le 2v<2^W$.
